name: weekly-top-rewards
author: Takaro
description: Weekly Top Rewards ranks players every week on playtime, kills and currency earned, using data Takaro already records. A cron job (default Sunday 20:00 UTC, change it in the cron job settings) pays the top 3 of each category with currency, optional items and an optional expiring role, broadcasts the winners and can post them to Discord. Players see live standings with /weeklytop [playtime|kills|currency|last]. Items for offline winners are delivered at their next login.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: What players are ranked on. playtime = time online this week, kills = entity kills, currency = currency earned from modules this week.

currencyRewards.title: Currency per place
currencyRewards.description: Currency for 1st, 2nd and 3rd place in each category. Use 0 for no currency.

firstPlaceItems.title: Items for 1st place
firstPlaceItems.description: Optional items for 1st place. Offline winners get them at their next login.

rewardRoleId.title: Winner role
rewardRoleId.description: Optional role every top-3 player gets for a limited time. Leave empty for no role.

rewardRoleDays.title: Winner role days
rewardRoleDays.description: How many days the winner role lasts before it expires.

minimumPlaytimeMinutes.title: Minimum playtime (minutes)
minimumPlaytimeMinutes.description: Players with less playtime this week are not ranked for playtime.

countManualCurrencyGrants.title: Count admin currency grants
countManualCurrencyGrants.description: Also count currency an admin added by hand in the dashboard. Off: only currency earned through modules counts. This module's own prizes never count.

maxCurrencyEventPages.title: Max currency event pages
maxCurrencyEventPages.description: Upper limit of 1000-event pages read to rank currency earned. Raise it on very busy servers.

discordChannelId.title: Discord channel ID
discordChannelId.description: Optional. Post the weekly winners to this Discord channel. Leave empty to turn it off.

weeklytop.helpText: Shows this week's top players. Use /weeklytop playtime, /weeklytop kills or /weeklytop currency for one category, /weeklytop last for last week's winners.

arguments.name: category
arguments.helpText: all, playtime, kills, currency or last

deliver-pending.description: Gives item prizes to winners who were offline when the week closed

award-weekly.description: Closes the week, pays the top 3 per category and starts a new week
